Learn hands-in skills so you can volunteer with the Rainbow Routes Association’s trail maintenance crew. Registration is required. Donations can be dropped off 5-8 p.m. May 20 and 1-4 p.m. May 21.Art: Through Ivan’s Eyes, a Northern Vision Lives is a special final exhibition and sale celebrating the work of beloved Northern Ontario realist painter Ivan Wheale at the Perivale Gallery on Manitoulin Island. The images are uploaded to Perivale Gallery’s website www.perivalegallery.com/ivan-wheale. Inquiries and sales by calling 705-210-0290. Doors open at 10 a.m. The Perivale Gallery is open Friday, Saturday and Sunday, from May 15 to June 14 and then daily until Sept. 20.Arts: SPARC conference will take place in Sudbury at Collège Boréal May 21-24. Secure your spot at sparcsymposium2026.eventbrite.ca. Become a SPARC member (membership is free) and save. Registrants can purchase a three-day or one-day pass. For tickets and more information, visit sudburyperformance.ca.Exhibition: People of the Watershed: Photographs by John Macfie will be exhibited at the Art Gallery of Sudbury, 174 Elgin St., May 9-27.
